interpretation.explicit-local: The requested leaf is explicit in the weapon parameter file.
interpretation.explicit-parent: The requested leaf is explicit in a declared $parent chain.
interpretation.leaf-omitted-schema-default-unresolved: The mechanism object exists, but the leaf is omitted and its schema/runtime default is not present in this snapshot.
interpretation.optional-mechanism-object-absent: The optional mechanism object itself is absent; dependent numeric fields may be classified as not applicable, but capability booleans remain unresolved unless explicitly stated.
interpretation.external-semantic-evidence-required: The value is not represented by this parameter schema and requires an official description or another auditable source.
